description: Guided by Dartanus, Dar turns from wandering protector toward the mystery of his own royal heritage and a larger quest against Balcifer that draws his family, allies and enemies into the final struggle.

s03e01.description: Guided by the spirit warrior Dartanus, Dar begins a journey to discover his true destiny.

s03e02.description: Dar is sent on a journey that begins revealing his true heritage as the son of King Eldar.

s03e03.description: Dar undertakes a quest to find his family and defeat Balcifer, the Lord of Darkness.

s03e04.description: Dar protects a white tiger that carries the spirit of his long-lost sister Lycia.

s03e05.description: The Sorceress and the Apparition compete for Balcifer’s favor by trying to corrupt Dar.

s03e06.description: Dar, Tao and Dartanus race to save Ruh from a ritual sacrifice intended to earn Balcifer’s favor.

s03e07.description: Dar risks his life to prevent Zuraya from marrying a timeless monster who seeks rebirth through their child.

s03e08.description: Dar enters Xinca to rescue a special horse despite a prophecy that the mission will end with his death by his own sword.

s03e09.description: King Zad gains an ally in Nadeea, a seductive succubus determined to destroy the Beastmaster.

s03e10.description: Dar helps the Orlas reclaim their devastated homeland but sacrifices a chance to find his mother.

s03e11.description: Dar loses faith in his quest after leading Arina into a deadly trap.

s03e12.description: Zad needs Dar’s help to stop the murderous spirit of a ruthless former ruler haunting Xinca.

s03e13.description: To rescue his brother, Dar must survive three dangerous tasks imposed by the spiteful demon Yamira.

s03e14.description: The Sorceress bargains for Sharak’s return to human form, creating a threat to Dar’s larger quest.

s03e15.description: Dar discovers that crucial information about his quest is hidden in the archives of the legendary Order of Vella.

s03e16.description: Dar meets Talia and her brother Galen, whose family holds an old agreement tying their house to Dar’s in an alliance against Balcifer.

s03e17.description: Curupira’s sister puts Dar on trial for allegedly failing his promise to protect the animals.

s03e18.description: Callista tries to win Balcifer’s favor by persuading Dar’s brother Sendar to claim King Eldar’s throne.

s03e19.description: Zad orders the smith who forged the Sword of Eldar to create a rival Sword of Balcifer.

s03e20.description: Dartanus shows Dar a vision of the world that could exist if he loses focus on his quest.

s03e21.description: As Dar nears the completion of his quest, Balcifer takes control of Arina and Tao in an attempt to destroy him.

s03e22.description: Dar must find the key that will release his family from the Crystal Ark and prevent Balcifer from plunging the world into eternal darkness.
